name: Mac battery
author: ryan
description: Shows the MacBook battery in the Omarchy bar by reading omarchy-utm-battery.json from a UTM shared folder. The icon keeps the last reading. Click it to choose a mount folder; mounting can ask for an admin password. While enabled, the widget re-reads the file every five seconds. It does not use the network.

barWidget.description: MacBook charge and charging state from a UTM shared folder.

schema.label: Status file
schema.description: Guest path of omarchy-utm-battery.json. Empty finds a mounted UTM share, or mounts one at ~/Mac.
